lines.text:
Hello, Cadet.
Let's be good friends.
Faithfulness is the most important quality of a knight-errant.
The Peony Association never engages in immoral acts.

Would you like to join my organization?
You're always welcome.

If you're ever having any difficulties, don't hesitate to reach out.
I can help.

I will be with you forever,
that I can promise you.
Cadet! Where are you?
I'll never abandon you, no matter what happens.

Are you calling for me, Cadet?
What's the matter?

What a lovely place!
I ought to bring my subordinates here for a tour later.

You want to show me around?
Okay!

I'm Moran, the leader of the Peony Association.
Starting from today, you are my Cadet.
Anyone who messes with you will have to answer to me.
Oh! I feel stronger!
Your safety is my top priority.

Huh? Is this for me?
Er... Thank you!

Your generosity makes me feel a bit embarrassed.
What could I possibly give in return?

Where did you get something so nice? 
Thanks so much.
Are you trying to suck up to me?

My heart is always beating whenever you're around.
Then again, I suppose that's what a heart is supposed to do.

Thank you for trusting me.
I'll make sure it does not go misplaced.
Leave it to me!
Let's go!
Loyalty! Loyalty! Loyalty!
Let's show them how powerful we are!
Let's go, guys!
Stay safe. Don't die out there!
I will knock them all down.
Wait a moment!
Don't give up, everyone!
I'll be back soon!
Shall we?
That's it? Bring forth your full strength!
Trust me and follow my lead!
This is fun!
Aren't I the best?
Haha, did you see that?
Ugh!
Agh!
Ah!
I'm sorry... I wasn't able to protect you.
Did you see me out there? I did great!
Wh-what's this...? This outfit's way too revealing! I can barely move in it.
I'm only wearing this because they asked me to play the villain... I didn't realize it'd be this revealing.
"Mwahaha, you foolish Ark Rangers!" Th-that's how I'm supposed to do it, right...?
Ugh... Can you not stare at me like that? I feel like I'm gonna die of embarrassment.
What do you think, Cadet? Do I at least look like a... s-sexy villain?
"Mwahaha! The Ark belongs to me, Darkflower the Shadow Empress!" Aaaagh... Acting this out is so embarrassing.
Cadet... If you left me here looking like this, I'm seriously gonna die from embarrassment. Can I go get changed?
You're not here, right, Cadet...? Might as well practice my lines while I wait... "You wretched Ark Rangers!" Oh... that was actually pretty good.
I can't believe I wore this to the Outpost. I need to get inside before Rosanna and Sakura see me!
Cadet, I'll be hiding out at the Trendy Bar, so make sure you come alone, got it? It'd be way too embarrassing for anyone else to see me.
Still, it's a bit better having you walk with me. *Sigh* But every time I take a step, the wind keeps sneaking up under there... I'm so embarrassed I could die.
Cadet, I'm gonna be in the Ark Rangers movie as a... s-sexy villain. Do you think I can, uh... pull it off?
Mwahaha, excellent... Oops, sorry! I've been practicing so much, it just kinda slips out sometimes.
Thanks for looking out for me, Cadet.
With you cheering me on, I'll give it everything I've got on set!
Wow, when did you put all this together? *Sniff* You're the best cadet I could ask for.
A gift to help with my acting? Thanks, Cadet. I'll put it to good use!
This is for Darkflower...? Uh... Then I guess I'm supposed to say, "Heh, I accept your offering!"
I-it's strange... Ever since I put this outfit on, I can't stop worrying about how you see me.
Your encouragement has helped improve my acting so much, Cadet. I can't thank you enough.
How do I look? Am I p-p-prett... I-I mean, I look cool, right? I think I'll be fine if you say I look cool...
We're not gonna have time to change before we go, are we?
D-did you just call me the Shadow Empress?
"Very well. It would appear this is a matter for Darkflower, the Shadow Empress." This is what you wanted, right?
Perfect! Something to distract me from my embarrassment. Let's fight!
I'm dying of embarrassment. Can we get this over with?
Come at me! The Shadow Empress, Darkflower, has arrived!
Good. Just thinking of fighting makes me feel better!
I'm all warmed up. Let's go again!
I keep worrying about my back in this outfit...
You're watching the battle and not my back... right?
Time to steal the show!
Ahem! "Kneel before Darkflower, the Shadow Empress!"
"Kill them all!" Mwahahahck *Cough, cough!*
One down!
Next!
Mwahaha! Oops, that just slipped out...
Oof.
Urgh...
How dare you!
Gah! My outfit...! Sorry, I gotta go get it fixed!
See that, Cadet? That's the strength of loyalty. It doesn't matter what I'm wearing!

favorite.name: Peony Hairpin
favorite.description: A hairpin that, although once broken, has now been mended by warm hands, becoming even more beautiful in the process. Within it lies the longing to appear beautiful and special to someone.
